headline: Iran war latest: 2nd US military aircraft downed in war with Iran
summary: The war with Iran is in its sixth week and may run at least two more weeks, with the Strait of Hormuz a major focal point to any ceasefire. A second US military aircraft has reportedly been downed.
why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of global seaborne oil and LNG, so military escalation there feeds directly into energy prices and supply expectations.
why_moved: Continued conflict around the Strait of Hormuz raises concern about disruption to oil and gas shipments, supporting energy prices.
